# Data Intellect

> > Data Intellect provides specialized KDB+ consultancy and capital markets technology solutions, featuring the TorQ framework for high-performance time-series data management.

Data Intellect (formerly AquaQ Analytics) is a global consultancy specializing in kdb+ development, performance engineering, and financial technology solutions for capital markets. With offices in Belfast, Jersey City, London, Hong Kong, and Singapore, the company delivers enterprise-grade data analytics platforms and frameworks.

## Key Topics

- kdb+ database and q language
- TorQ framework
- Capital markets technology
- Time-series data management
- qsql query language
- Performance engineering
- Financial technology solutions
- Data analytics platforms
- CI/CD for trading platforms
- Apache Arrow integration
- Kubernetes deployment
- Data access APIs
- Solution delivery
- Global consultancy services
